generator._aqueduct_note: An aqueduct runs straight out along bearing_deg, offset_m to the right of the line through the centre (clear of the gate). Spans are 10 m centred every 10 m from inner_m (the inner wall line), spans_in inwards and spans_out outwards (20 reaches past the outer wall at 330), with a ramp at both ends. Where it crosses a wall, the wall runs on under the span (wall top 4.1 m, deck underside 4.2 m): the ground stays closed, the wall walk is cut there (1.2 m head room).
generator._max_cover_walls_note: Lead's density cap for the whole map (group cover_wall): the cover index validates every wall once per frame, about 0.47 us per wall on the desktop (P1c, 433 walls 205 us), several times that on a phone. tests/test_alesia_1km.gd checks the built count against it.
generator._todo: OQ-ALESIA-LAYOUT: every number and name in this block is a proposal (a guess for Shibi). Bearings are compass degrees (0 = north = -z, 90 = east = +x). A ring radius is the apothem: the distance from the centre to the middle of each straight side (gates and towers sit there).

camps._note: 6 blocks at bearings 15 + 60 k (allowed 4-6), clear of the three aqueducts. Cover 12 in a 60 x 60 m block is about half alesia's 131 cover walls per 160 m x 160 m.

fields._note: about a tenth of alesia's density: 150 low cover on the 330,000 m2 annulus.

hill._note: a flat top 45 m across, then a smoothstep fall to 0 at radius_m: steepest about 29 degrees (navmesh agent max slope 45, pawn floor_max_angle 45).

inner_wall._note: 24 sides (allowed 16-24, proposal 20): the gates on the diagonals and a side square to each cardinal for the aqueducts both sit on side middles only when the side count divides by 8.

outer_wall._note: 32 sides (allowed 32-40, proposal 36): with 32 the 4 cardinal gates, the 8 towers half-way between them and the aqueduct crossings all sit on side middles.

reserved._note: J1 spots (binding fix 14): places only, no nodes. jump pads at the inner foot of the outer wall, past the outer aqueduct ends and at the hill foot; man cannons from the fields to the camp ring and from the camp ring towards the citadel; lily traps in front of the outer gates and on the stake lines of the fields.

ground_paint._todo: OQ-ALESIA-LAYOUT / OQ-GFX-MATERIALS: art_materials.json "ground" keys for this map only. citadel_paving_m = the hill's radius (paved citadel); the ring road runs just inside the inner wall; earth from the hill to the outer wall (the camp ring); grass from the outer wall out (the fields). paint_px_per_m 1.024 gives a 1024 px paint (1 px per 0.98 m), under paint_px_cap 2048. roads false: no spokes from the origin to every landmark. baked: the paint is painted offline by tools/gen_alesia.gd (painting 1 km in GDScript at load is too slow); a missing or stale bake paints at load with one printed line.
